name: Daggers
description: A quick weapon for every material

pages.title: Daggers
pages.text:
A **dagger** hits for less than a sword but swings faster.

**Backstab:** hitting a mob from behind deals 50%% more damage. Catch mobs while they're busy with something else.

pages.title: Material Traits
pages.text: Weapon traits count for daggers too. A silver dagger still hits the undead harder, and an infernium dagger still sets mobs alight.
One of the material over a stick makes a dagger.
